meta.title: Damicon - farm management for the raspberry plantation
meta.description: Damicon is the farm-management system for a raspberry farm near Almaty: the harvest run, the cold chain with a 60-minute threshold, crate identity in the field, contribution margin per harvest day and an unbroken chain of evidence for every delivery.

hero.badge: Farm management for the raspberry plantation · near Almaty
hero.headline: Market leadership is won not through tonnage, but through verifiable traceability.
hero.subheadline: The raspberry has no protective skin and has to be cooled within 60 minutes. Damicon controls the multi-week harvest run, holds the cold chain and documents every delivery down to the row block, the cooling time and the person.

landing.berryTitle: The most delicate berry in the fresh-produce range
landing.berryLead: It has no protective skin, is hollow inside and highly prone to grey mould. Software alone saves no berry - but it runs exactly the hour, the rotation and the records that the price depends on.

schale.title: No protective skin
schale.text: Unrefrigerated, the raspberry is no longer marketable after about a day. Properly pre-cooled it keeps two to three days, up to five with excellent handling.

kuehlung.title: 60 minutes to cooling
kuehlung.text: No more than 60 minutes may pass between picking and cooling. Break that limit and every further measure is worthless.

umpacken.title: Pick straight into the retail punnet
umpacken.text: The retail-ready punnet is made in the picker's hand. Any repacking or re-sorting destroys the goods.

feld.title: Quality is decided in the field
feld.text: The quality call happens at the picker. It has to be captured and measured there, not at a central sorting station.

rhythmus.title: A conveyor belt, not a peak
rhythmus.text: Everbearing varieties bear from August to the first frost. Every row block is picked every two to three days, over three to eight weeks.

schaden.title: One berry devalues the punnet
schaden.text: A single leaking or damaged berry makes the whole punnet unsellable. A pure piece rate is therefore value-destroying.

landing.berryQuote: A peak you survive with many hands. A conveyor belt over six weeks you survive only with a plan.
landing.spreadEyebrow: The price spread is the business case
landing.spreadTitle: Between loose ware and premium lies a factor of 2.3
landing.spreadLead: The Almaty market pays about 1,500 tenge per kilogram for loose fresh ware off the field, and up to 3,500 tenge for ware picked and marketed on the same day. The difference is not made in the field.

lose.label: Loose fresh ware off the field
lose.note: Sold from the field and via classifieds. Impossible to undercut on price.

schale.label: Punnet ware, tunnel / greenhouse
schale.note: Polka and Babje leto varieties. The punnet creates the premium, not the berry.

premium.label: Premium, picked the same day
premium.note: Marketed directly. Freshness, consistency and verifiability are the entire added value.

landing.spreadFactorText: That much extra revenue per season comes from every 10-percentage-point shift of volume into the upper price segment - at three hectares. The lever is cooling time, punnet quality, delivery reliability and verifiability.
landing.proofTitle: An unbroken chain of evidence for every delivery
landing.proofLead: The farm that is the only one able to trace every delivery back to the row block, the cooling time and the person becomes the standard against which trade measures the others.

kuehlkurve.title: Cooling curve
kuehlkurve.text: Time and temperature from picking to pre-cooling, a hard 60-minute limit, temperature logger all the way to the client.

charge.title: Batch
charge.text: Every crate carries an identifier assigned in the field and belongs to exactly one batch - from the crate to the invoice.

herkunftsblock.title: Source block
herkunftsblock.text: Row block, variety and harvest day as cost object and origin declaration per batch.

pfluecker.title: Picker
pfluecker.text: Volume, row block, time and person are captured in one scan when the crate is handed over.

behandlung.title: Treatment record
behandlung.text: Every plant-protection treatment locks the row block automatically until the pre-harvest interval expires. Residue proof per batch at the press of a button.

landing.proofClosing: On a complaint it can be established within seconds which block, which person and which cooling time the ware came from.
landing.leversLead: Each lever stands on its own, but they build on each other. Without the first, the other three are worthless.

stunde.title: The hour after picking
stunde.text: Fixed collection rounds, pre-cooling at 0 to 1 degree, timing with a 60-minute threshold. The price difference collapses in the first hour in the field, not in the sales conversation.

herbstfenster.title: The autumn window
herbstfenster.text: With everbearing varieties the autumn yield is the main yield, and regional supply is thin. The rotation plan holds picking discipline over six weeks - one missed round destroys the block for that cycle.

zugang.title: Traceability as an access advantage
zugang.text: Large retail chains only take on verifiable suppliers. Anyone who can show the chain from crate to invoice becomes reachable for these buyers in the first place. The regulatory burden turns into an advantage.

aggregation.title: Aggregation instead of buying land
aggregation.text: Own harvest and buy-in from neighbouring farms under one brand, one quality class and continuous traceability - with separate batch tracking per farm. Growth without buying land.

landing.zonesLead: From the row-block map to the B2B portal, from the cold-chain clock to the contribution margin per harvest day. All areas share the same batch and the same role management.
landing.kpiLead: Measured during the analysis week and signed off together as the starting value. Without signed starting values there is no proof of success later.
landing.kpiFootnote: Prototype: placeholder values. The real calculation follows with the harvest data of the first fully measured season.
landing.complianceTitle: The regulatory burden turns into an access advantage
landing.complianceLead: In 2026 Kazakhstan reset the legal framework for digital matters in a series of laws. For a farm that fully meets these obligations, the burden becomes the entry ticket to organised trade.

steuer.title: Tax Code 2026
steuer.text: VAT 16 %, registration threshold at 43.25 million tenge. A growing farm slips into the tax obligation - without a clean chain of records that is a risk.

warenbegleit.title: Electronic goods-accompanying document
warenbegleit.text: Since 01 Jan 2026 every delivery is documented electronically via the ЭСФ system. The accompanying document is the central goods and accounting record, paper only on failure.

ki.title: AI Act No. 230-VIII
ki.text: The AI chat needs a visible transparency notice, purpose-bound consent, logging and escalation to a human. Emotion analysis is prohibited.

digitalkodex.title: Digital Code No. 255-VIII
digitalkodex.text: Restricts the storage of certain data products outside Kazakhstan. The hosting location is reviewed legally before going live.

datenschutz.title: Tightened data-protection law
datenschutz.text: Since 24 Aug 2026: purpose-bound consent, retention periods, named controllers, encryption, multi-factor authentication, annual mandatory training.

esutd.title: ЕСУТД employment-contract registration
esutd.text: The start, change and end of every seasonal contract is recorded in the unified system. Often not done for seasonal workers today - a risk of up to 2,000 MRP.

landing.complianceClosing: Large chains with their own supply chain only take on suppliers who can produce evidence. Compliance here is not a formality but the admission ticket.
landing.ctaTitle: A tangible system instead of concept slides
landing.ctaLead: The prototype shows the structure and look of the first release: row-block control with the pre-harvest-interval lock, picking tasks with photo evidence, the cold-chain clock and contribution margin per harvest day.
landing.faqTitle: Six questions that always come up in the first meeting
landing.faqLead: Short answers with the figures shown on this page.

sechzig.a: No more than 60 minutes may pass between picking and cooling down. Once that limit is missed, every later measure is ineffective - which is why the system measures this span per batch, not as a daily average.

durchgang.q: What happens if a picking pass is missed?
durchgang.a: Every row block is picked every two to three days, across three to eight weeks. A missed pass destroys that block for the cycle. The rotation plan keeps the order and shows the gap on the same day.

beleg.a: Every crate carries an identifier assigned in the field and belongs to exactly one batch. Row block, variety, harvest day, picking time, cooling curve and treatment record hang on it - through to the electronic delivery note in the ЭСФ system.

rollen.a: The role of the signed-in account decides, and it decides in the database, not in the interface. Seven core roles from administration to the individual picker; a gap in the frontend therefore exposes no foreign data.

stand.a: {gesamt} modules across four areas: {entwicklung, plural, =0 {all on the database with real writes} other {{angebunden} on the database with real writes, {entwicklung} as visible menu entries under development}}. The figures on the start page are placeholders until the first fully measured season.

daten.a: Digital Code No. 255-VIII restricts storing certain data products outside Kazakhstan. The hosting location is therefore reviewed legally before going live; keys and credentials never live in the source code.

feld.description: Location model, row-block status including the pre-harvest-interval lock, picking tasks with photo evidence, rotation plan and weather link.

hof.name: Yard
hof.description: Pre-cooling with a 60-minute KPI, temperature logger, collection rounds, QR crate identification and electronic delivery note.

buero.name: Office
buero.description: Roles and permissions, contribution margin per row block and harvest day, quality-factor pay, document management, compliance cockpit and the state integrations.

standort.title: Location hierarchy
standort.description: Farm, plantation, field plot, row group, row block - a digital field map with a unique row and block identifier along the trellises.
standort.summary: Field map with row blocks on the trellis, variety, planting year, cane type and trellis orientation per block.
standort.todo: A screen for creating and moving parcels and row groups, and for drawing the field geometry.

reihenbloecke.title: Row blocks and status
reihenbloecke.description: Every row block has one status: planted, ready to harvest, dormant, pruning or harvest-locked. A locked block simply must not appear in the picking schedule.
reihenbloecke.summary: Every row block carries its own status. While a pre-harvest interval is running, it stays locked for harvesting until that interval expires.
reihenbloecke.todo: Status changes with a mandatory reason, and a history per row block.

pflueckaufgaben.title: Picking tasks with photo evidence
pflueckaufgaben.description: A picking task per brigade and row block with target and actual volume, quality factor and photo evidence of the retail punnet right on the task.
pflueckaufgaben.summary: Task per brigade and row block, photo evidence of the retail punnet, volume and quality factor on the task.
pflueckaufgaben.todo: Offline capture in the field, evidence review with release and rework, link to quality-factor pay.

pflanzenschutz.title: Plant protection and pre-harvest interval
pflanzenschutz.description: Every treatment is recorded with product, quantity, block, date and the person applying it, and locks the row block automatically until the statutory pre-harvest interval expires.
pflanzenschutz.summary: Block-level treatment records with an automatic harvest lock. A breach is a legal and food-safety risk.
pflanzenschutz.todo: Pesticide database with pre-harvest intervals, automatic release on deadline, mandatory record upload, residue proof per batch.

rotationsplan.title: Rotation plan / picking schedule
rotationsplan.description: A rolling picking schedule with an interval of two to three days per row block across the whole autumn harvest. One missed round destroys the block for that cycle.
rotationsplan.summary: Shows which row block is due when, spreading the passes across the six weeks of the harvest.
rotationsplan.todo: Automatic interval calculation per row block, brigade assignment, a check for conflicts with pre-harvest locks, calendar export (.ics).

wetter.title: Weather and growing degree days
wetter.description: Weather data per location with a growing-degree-day calculation as the basis for the volume forecast.
wetter.summary: A simple weather interface with growing degree days per plot. Explainable, verifiable and validatable within a season.
wetter.todo: A weather station on the farm instead of the values from the network, and a note on shifted ripening windows.

kuehlkette.title: Cold-chain clock
kuehlkette.description: Timing from picking to pre-cooling with a hard 60-minute threshold, temperature logger, target temperature 0 to 1 degree. Highest priority in the whole farm.
kuehlkette.summary: Tracks the time from picking to pre-cooling. Over 60 minutes the ware is only industrial ware the next day.
kuehlkette.todo: Connecting temperature loggers so the readings do not have to be entered by hand.

logistik.title: Collection rounds and route planning
logistik.description: Pickup rounds at neighbouring farms with the 60-minute cold chain rule, so that filled crates do not stand in the sun, plus delivery tour planning.
logistik.summary: Handover receipt with volume and temperature reconciliation (pre-cooling and transport), unbroken cold-chain evidence all the way to the customer.
logistik.todo: Vehicle capacity and customer delivery time windows are still missing.

qr_steigen.title: QR crate identification
qr_steigen.description: QR labels for crates (linking to the public origin lookup), picker ID badges carrying their own badge code without biometrics, and a sign-in-free wall poster - all three can be printed straight from the browser.
qr_steigen.summary: The QR code carries identity from the field to the shop counter - the badge can be scanned by camera at the collection point to attribute a crate or work time to that person, instead of choosing them from a dropdown.
qr_steigen.todo: The crate labels cannot be scanned with the camera yet, only the picker badge.

esf.title: Electronic delivery note (ЭСФ)
esf.description: Document register for the electronic invoice (ЭСФ): which delivery has which document and which has none yet. The details for the portal are prepared, issuing stays in the state system.
esf.summary: Shows the deliveries without ЭСФ, prepares the details from delivery, price list and VAT status and tracks the status up to confirmation. Mandatory integration, the link follows once the authority grants access.
esf.todo: Stage 2: automatic handover to ИС ЭСФ and status feedback once the authority grants access.

rollen.title: Roles and permissions
rollen.description: Eight core roles, from the CEO and administration through farm management and accounting to the brigade and the individual picker in the field, the grower and the B2B client, with a permission matrix over resources and actions.
rollen.summary: Sets out who may see and change what. A new role can be added without changing anything in the modules.
rollen.todo: Creating and blocking staff accounts, fine-grained access rules per resource.

finanzen.title: Contribution margin and finance
finanzen.description: Cost centres per row block, cost objects per variety and per client. Contribution margin per kilogram, per row block, per variety and per harvest day - immutable postings.
finanzen.summary: Contribution margin per row block, variety and harvest day. Postings are immutable (append only).
finanzen.todo: Cost types per harvest day, B2B payment reconciliation, contribution-margin projection per variety.

personal.title: Picker register and brigades
personal.description: A person register with a picker ID badge, brigade assignment, output and quality factor per person across the season - the basis for bonuses, retraining and selection the following year.
personal.summary: Person register, brigade and picker ID badge, output and quality profile per person across the season.
personal.todo: ЕСУТД registration per contract, brigade planning, output history as the basis for pay calculation.

lohn.title: Quality-factor pay
lohn.description: This is where pickers' pay is calculated for a period: base pay from hours worked plus a volume share from the kilograms picked, multiplied by a quality factor (less waste, higher factor). The result is one settlement per person, which accounting approves and pays out, including the statutory deductions.
lohn.summary: Base pay plus volume plus a quality factor. The quality factor is not optional but a precondition.
lohn.todo: The minimum wage as a hard floor, editing the pay rates with a preview of the corridor, a payslip as PDF per picker, an advance account.

dokumente.title: Document management
dokumente.description: A secure store and evidence register for certificates, contracts, permits, insurance, spray records, ЕСУТД evidence and grant dossiers, with validity period, automatic expiry status and a responsible person, linked to the row block, the batch and partners.
dokumente.summary: A categorised, secure document store with automatic expiry status, a responsible person and links to row block, batch and partners.

compliance.title: Compliance cockpit
compliance.description: Processing purposes, consents, data incidents and third-party disclosures from five granular tables - reading and writing reserved to office roles only.
compliance.summary: Granular data-protection schema: processing purposes, consents, incidents and disclosures in one place.
compliance.todo: Legal citations from the tax code, the AI act and the digital code, retention periods per kind of data, a check of the storage location.

integrationen.title: State integrations
integrationen.description: Reporting process for the unified system ЕСУТД: conclusion, change and termination of seasonal contracts with deadline, confirmation and proof. Connectors to ЭСФ, virtual stock and the funding portals gosagro.kz and qoldau.kz are planned. Accounting stays with a solution established in the country.
integrationen.summary: Tracks the reports to ЕСУТД and reminds of the deadline for the conclusion. The automatic handover follows once the authority grants access.
integrationen.todo: Stage 2: connectors per system with test access, handling of errors and retries, overview of the pending operations.

foerdermittel.title: Grant application dossier
foerdermittel.description: Application templates, evidence lists and a deadline monitor for the Kazakh subsidy portals - eligibility as a by-product of ongoing bookkeeping.
foerdermittel.summary: Deadline monitor and per-dossier evidence documents are connected. Application templates and evidence checklists per grant programme remain open.
foerdermittel.todo: Application templates and evidence checklists per grant programme. The first open question is which fields and documents gosagro.kz and qoldau.kz ask for per programme.

wirtschaftlichkeit.title: Business case for the rollout
wirtschaftlichkeit.description: Investment appraisal for the rollout from recorded items: payback period, return in year one and over three years, one-off and recurring cost, net present value. With assumptions, plan versus actual and saved snapshots.
wirtschaftlichkeit.summary: Payback, return, one-off and recurring cost and net present value of the rollout, calculated from recorded items, with plan versus actual and snapshots.
wirtschaftlichkeit.todo: The benefit counts as evidenced only once operations deliver actual figures. Until then it is shown as estimated.

sortenkatalog.title: Variety and quota catalogue
sortenkatalog.description: A catalogue of variety, harvest window (summer-bearing or everbearing), punnet weight, quota and price list - the basis for pre-order and the B2B portal.
sortenkatalog.summary: Variety, harvest window, punnet weight, quota and price in one place.
sortenkatalog.todo: Quota booking with reservation logic, price-list versions, client assignment.

b2b_portal.title: B2B portal
b2b_portal.description: A regular-client portal with quotas, pre-order with lead time, a price list by client group, delivery status, invoice history and complaint reporting.
b2b_portal.summary: Delivery status with handover receipt, price list, and pre-orders with manual office confirmation are connected.
b2b_portal.todo: Automatic quota consumption, tiered pricing per customer group and an invoice history. How exactly these should work has not been decided yet.

preislisten.title: Price lists
preislisten.description: Versioned price lists with tiered prices by client group and validity period.
preislisten.summary: Price tiers per client and period, versioned and with a validity date.
preislisten.todo: Nothing left open: versions through the validity date, tiers through the minimum quantity and the assignment per customer group are all connected.

aggregator.title: Aggregator / neighbouring farms
aggregator.description: Connecting neighbouring farms: the purchased volume becomes an invoice line, every buy-in batch is tracked separately and remains traceable to the supplying farm.
aggregator.summary: Neighbouring-farm onboarding, buy-in capture with its own batch, separate origin tracking, settlement.
aggregator.todo: A margin per neighbouring farm instead of a single one for all, and the payout itself.

schulungen.title: Training videos
schulungen.description: Multilingual short induction of seasonal workers on the phone: six steps, each with a large pictogram and little text, plus the mandatory training.
schulungen.summary: A six-step induction with pictograms, multilingual, with its own progress per person, plus the mandatory training.
schulungen.todo: Videos per core process, filmed and dubbed into Kazakh and Russian.

kanaele.title: Contact channels
kanaele.description: Locally established contact channels and payment methods, shown publicly in the website footer. Display only, no connection to a real messenger or payment service.
kanaele.summary: WhatsApp, Kaspi QR and other channels as contact details - maintained by the office, hidden as a draft until then.

wirtschaftlichkeitAnsicht.lead: What the step costs, when the money is back and what owning it costs, over three years.
wirtschaftlichkeitAnsicht.modellHinweis: Model calculation dated {stichtag}. The figures come from the management's metric list, not from live operations. Anything estimated is marked on the tile.
wirtschaftlichkeitAnsicht.kursHinweis: Converted at the National Bank of Kazakhstan rate of {stichtag}: 1 EUR = {euro} ₸, 1 RUB = {rubel} ₸.
wirtschaftlichkeitAnsicht.jahresnutzenSatz: Every figure rests on an assumed annual benefit of {tenge} ({rubel}). That number is back-calculated and not yet evidenced by operations.

wirtschaftlichkeitAnsicht.fussnote: Return, payback and the cost per kilogram hang on the annual benefit. If the reduction per kilogram looks too high, the annual benefit is set too high. The actual values further down show whether it materialises in operations.

amortisation.label: Payback period
amortisation.frage: When do I get my money back?
amortisation.rechenweg: One-off plus recurring cost, divided by annual benefit, times twelve.

roiJahr1.label: Return year 1
roiJahr1.frage: Is it worth anything at all?
roiJahr1.rechenweg: Annual benefit less one-off and recurring cost, divided by both combined.

roiDreiJahre.label: Return over 3 years
roiDreiJahre.rechenweg: Three times the annual benefit less one-off and three times recurring cost, divided by the outlay.

capex.label: Cost to acceptance
capex.rechenweg: Fixed price up to acceptance. One number, not a range.
capex.rechenwegErfasst: Sum of the recorded investment items.

opex.label: Recurring cost per year
opex.rechenweg: Hosting, maintenance, support and further development.
opex.rechenwegErfasst: Sum of the recorded operating items per year.

tco.label: Total cost over 3 years
tco.frage: What does the comparison really cost?
tco.rechenweg: One-off cost plus three years of recurring cost, against any alternative.

vermiedeneKosten.label: Avoided cost per year
vermiedeneKosten.frage: Where does the benefit come from?
vermiedeneKosten.rechenweg: Shrinkage, manual work and audit preparation. Back-calculated from the given return figures.
vermiedeneKosten.rechenwegErfasst: Sum of the recorded benefit items per year: shrinkage, manual work, audit preparation and other.

kapitalwert.label: Net present value
kapitalwert.frage: Does it hold up with the CFO?
kapitalwert.rechenweg: Present value of the benefit less the investment over three years, discounted monthly at {zins}.

kostenJeKilogramm.label: Cost per kilogram
kostenJeKilogramm.rechenweg: Full cost divided by the marketed quantity, before against after. Needs operational figures.
kostenJeKilogramm.rechenwegMitWerten: Full cost divided by the marketed quantity. Before {vorher} ₸, less {ersparnis} ₸ benefit per kilogram at {menge} kg annual volume.
kostenJeKilogramm.rechenwegMengeOffen: The marketed annual quantity is still missing. It comes from the deliveries once they cover a full year, or by hand from the assumptions.

nutzenbeginn.label: Time to first benefit
nutzenbeginn.frage: From when does it pay in?
nutzenbeginn.rechenweg: Weeks to live operation, counted against the frost edge.

horizontalesMonitoring.readinessText: Horizontal monitoring requires ongoing, structured visibility into a company's own accounting. Damicon already produces that trail by design:

loeschen.warnung: Warning: the document and all its sections are removed from the knowledge base for good. This cannot be undone. The assistant will no longer find it.

seiten.titel: Pages are missing from the scan

"2@105-107 (PDF 106-108)" means: two pages are missing somewhere between printed pages 105 and 107, within PDF pages 106 to 108, because no page number was readable on at least one of them. Please look at these PDF pages in the original.
seiten.platzhalter: for example: Blank pages in the book
seiten.regel: Enter below the printed page numbers that are correctly missing from the book (for example blank or note pages). The entry must cover all open gaps. If real content is missing, the book will not be approved: load the missing pages as a PDF or delete the book and upload the whole PDF again.
seiten.unbekannt: {anzahl, plural, one {# further missing page is} other {# further missing pages are}} not known individually (too many gaps or not readable). This cannot be confirmed. Please rescan and upload the whole PDF again.
seiten.bestaetigt: Printed page numbers that are correctly missing (required for approval)
seiten.angabeUngueltig: The entry is invalid. Page numbers and ranges separated by commas are allowed, for example 48-49, 120.
seiten.abgedeckt: All open gaps are covered ({seiten, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}} confirmed as correctly missing).
seiten.nichtAbgedeckt: Not covered: {anzahl, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}, locations: {stellen}. Without these pages real content is missing and the book cannot be approved.
seiten.uebrig: These page numbers do not belong to any open gap and do not count: {liste}.
seiten.gesperrt: Approval is only possible once all gaps are covered. Rejecting is always possible.

nachladen.keineZuordnung: No page of the file matches an open gap. Nothing was loaded.

nachladen.lesenFehler: The file could not be read or loaded. Is it a valid PDF with a text layer?

farmReality.eyebrow: The farm, not a photo library
farmReality.title: Real footage instead of stock photos
farmReality.lead: These images show the plantation near Almaty before digitalisation - including what isn't right yet. A presence that shows only the successes reads to a buyer as advertising; one that names the open issue itself reads as a status report.
farmReality.bandCaption: The plantation, looking south toward the Zailiyskiy Alatau range
farmReality.photo1Text: Everbearing, fruits on first-year cane. Ripe and green berries hang at the same time - which is why every block is picked every two to three days.
farmReality.photo2Text: 5 to 15 minutes pass from picking to the cold room. That figure is good and does not need improving.
farmReality.photo3Text: The same ware in storage, poured loose at around +16 °C instead of near 0 °C. Raspberries carry no weight of their own: whatever lies beneath the top layer gets crushed - and at this temperature it keeps ripening.

existingAssets.title: This does not start at zero
existingAssets.lead: The farm has equipment, irrigation and its own product. What is missing is not equipment, but proof of what went where and when.
existingAssets.asset1Text: Own tractor for maintenance and transport.
existingAssets.asset2Text: Own spraying equipment. Every treatment triggers a pre-harvest interval - the system locks the block for it automatically.
existingAssets.asset3Text: Water storage and tanks on site, plus its own transformer station - power does not depend on the local grid.
existingAssets.asset4Text: Raspberry jam under its own label, bilingual. Second-choice fruit already has a path - exactly what a quality standard requires.

qualityStandard.eyebrow: The same standard as in the system
qualityStandard.title: The standard lives here, not in a brochure
qualityStandard.lead: Whoever picks for the farm or buys from it sees the same standard that applies in the system - the same criteria the picker's phone asks for. The technical basis is UNECE standard FFV-32 for raspberries.
qualityStandard.q1Text: Evenly coloured, hollow inside, the drupelets hold together. The receptacle stays on the cane.
qualityStandard.q2Text: The white receptacle is still lodged in the berry. It was pulled off by force instead of lifted away, and loses juice in transport.
qualityStandard.q3Text: Grey coating, even at just one spot. Stays in the field: inside a closed punnet it infects the whole layer overnight.
qualityStandard.trayTitle: The costliest mistake is a height
qualityStandard.trayText: Seen from above, the overfilled punnet looks best: full, dense, no gap. But the lid presses on the top layer, and the bottom layer carries the weight. Raspberries carry no weight of their own - by the time it's in the shop, the bottom layer is juice. That is visible only from the side.
qualityStandard.vergleichText: On the left an unblemished fruit, on the right one with grey mould - two photographs of the same variety, not the same berry. Drag the slider: the difference takes hours, not days, and in a closed punnet it spreads to the whole layer overnight.
qualityStandard.vergleichRegler: Move the comparison slider between the two photographs

pruefungPdf.haftung: This report was created by an AI system from the business data and the knowledge base. It does not replace legal or tax advice. The seal (SHA-256 over the canonical report content) allows verifying that the report has not been altered since it was created.
pruefungPdf.auszugSiegelHinweis: Excerpt from the fully sealed report; the seal applies to the complete report.
pruefungPdf.fussVertraulich: Confidential · for the intended recipients only

legende.verstoss: Violation: the business data show a breach of an obligation or an overdue obligation.
legende.luecke: Gap: an obligation is not evidenced or the data are incomplete.
legende.hinweis: Note: cannot be assessed (no business data or no clear legal source).
legende.konform: Compliant: business data and law show that the obligation is met.
legende.stufen: Audit readiness (0 to 100): 85 and above ready, 60 to 84 with gaps, below 60 not ready.

methodik.absatz1: The audit was carried out by an AI system with several specialised agents. Each audit item has its own team: a collector reads the business data from the database, a lawyer researches the legal sources in the knowledge base, and an auditor assesses both and writes the finding. A coordinator combines the results.
methodik.absatz2: Every legal statement names its source. Without a valid legal source or without business data, a finding is downgraded to a note. Audit readiness is calculated from the severity of the evidenced violations and gaps and is not estimated by the model.

freigabe.text: Noted and approved for further use.

pruefungPdf.verifikation: The content of this report is sealed with a SHA-256 checksum. Anyone with the accompanying JSON file can recompute the seal in Damicon with "Verify seal"; any later change is detected.
pruefungPdf.tipp: Tip for the print dialog: turn "Headers and footers" off, paper size A4. Colours and branding are applied automatically.
pruefungPdf.nutzungNotfalls: Unreliable internet source, not an official source. Used only as a last resort, please verify against an official source.
pruefungPdf.nutzungHinweis: Indicative only, not sufficient on its own (specialist source, not a primary source).
pruefungPdf.quellenlageWert: {amtlich} official or legal sources (levels 1 to 3) · {fach} specialist sources · {unsicher} unreliable internet sources

erklaerung.titel: How the risk score is built
erklaerung.lead: Five weighted factors. Weights and thresholds are stored with their rationale in the database (table risiko_parameter); only admin and ceo may change them.

ueberfaellig.name: Missed round
ueberfaellig.regel: The oldest open task or the oldest open rotation date is overdue. From {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of delay the factor counts as full, because a whole round is lost by then.

sperre.name: Waiting-period lock
sperre.regel: If an open task falls due before the lock ends, that is a conflict: the factor is full and the level is always high. Otherwise every round lost to the lock counts proportionally, full from {durchgaenge, plural, one {# round} other {# rounds}}.

ausschuss.name: Waste
ausschuss.regel: Waste rate over the last {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Zero at the target of {ziel} percent, full at {kritisch} percent.

kuehlkette.name: Cold chain
kuehlkette.regel: Violations of the 60-minute rule for batches of the block in the last {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, full from {anzahl, plural, one {# violation} other {# violations}}.

erfassung.name: Recording gap
erfassung.regel: Work was done on the block in the last {aktiv, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}, but there is no open task and none from the last {tage, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.

erklaerung.schwellen: Level high from {hoch} points, medium from {mittel}. A conflict with the waiting-period lock is always high.

rollenZuweisung.lead: An account's role decides what it may see and do. A change applies from the next page the account opens.
rollenZuweisung.hinweis: The last administrator keeps the role. Your own role cannot be changed here.

esfAnsicht.nurLesen: View only: administration, CEO and accounting can record entries.

esutdAnsicht.titel: Reporting process in the unified system (ЕСУТД)
esutdAnsicht.lead: The conclusion, change and termination of every seasonal contract belong in the state unified system ЕСУТД. The list shows what is to be reported, what has been reported and what proves it. Reporting is still done in the state system, Damicon keeps the status.
esutdAnsicht.stufeHinweis: The reporting deadlines come from the settings: conclusion {abschluss} working days after signing (otherwise after the start of the contract), amendment {aenderung} calendar days, termination {beendigung} working days. Saturday and Sunday do not count, there is no public holiday calendar. Automatic reporting follows once the authority's access is available.
esutdAnsicht.nurLesen: View only: administration, CEO and farm management can record entries.

abschluss.unterschriftHinweis: The reporting deadline runs from here.

esf.titelRegister: Document register of the electronic invoice
esf.untertitelRegister: Deliveries without ЭСФ and status of the documents
esf.umfangWert: {offen} deliveries without an issued document, {belege} documents
esf.zusammenfassungRegister: Which delivered shipment has which ЭСФ document and which has none yet. The ЭСФ is issued in the state portal.
esf.zusammenfassungBeleg: Details for the state portal and status of this document.
esf.keinErsatz: This document does not replace the ЭСФ. It records the details and the status, the electronic invoice is issued in the state system.

lieferung.zusammenfassungMitUrteil: Overall rating of the cold chain: {urteil}. The worst measurement from pre-cooling and transport decides.
lieferung.zusammenfassungOhneUrteil: There is no temperature measurement for this delivery yet.
lieferung.nochNichtUebergeben: The delivery has not been handed over yet.
lieferung.regel: Rating per measurement: up to 4 °C fine, up to 8 °C warning, above that violation. Values from a logger file carry the origin logger and the identifier of the device.
lieferung.keineMessungen: No measurement was recorded for the transport.

nachweise.zusammenfassung: The status follows from the period: valid, expiring, expired or open. It is not set by hand.
nachweise.regelStatus: Valid until is the last day of validity. On the following day the proof counts as expired. The day changes at midnight in Almaty.
nachweise.regelOffen: Open means: no period recorded or not yet in force. The system does not invent dates, a proof without a period stands out as a gap.

lieferplan.zusammenfassung: Firmly planned deliveries on a tour and pre-orders with a requested date, without duplicates.
lieferplan.regel: A pre-order that already has a planned delivery on a tour is not listed twice: the day of the tour counts, not the request. The customer sees only their own dates.

knopf.hinweis: Opens the document in the Damicon layout in a new tab. There it can be printed or saved as PDF.

wirtschaftlichkeit.zusammenfassung: Calculated from {anzahl} recorded items. {geschaetzt} figures rest on estimates, {offen} are still open because information is missing.
wirtschaftlichkeit.zusammenfassungModell: Model calculation based on the management's metric list of 23 September 2026, not from live operations.
wirtschaftlichkeit.zusammenfassungLeer: No items are recorded yet, so every figure is open.
wirtschaftlichkeit.hinweiseTitel: To keep in mind when assessing

hinweis.modell: Model calculation without a database connection: the values come from the metric list of 23 September 2026.

hinweis.geschaetzt: Estimated, because they depend on assumptions that operations have not yet evidenced: {liste}.

abholauftrag.planungOffen: No route was calculated for this round, so there is no driving time estimate.
abholauftrag.planungOk: Estimated drive from the first stop to the cold store: {minuten} minutes. That fits into the 60 minutes.
abholauftrag.planungKnapp: Estimated drive from the first stop to the cold store: {minuten} minutes. That is tight: the clock already runs from the start of picking, before the vehicle arrives.
abholauftrag.planungZuLang: Estimated drive from the first stop to the cold store: {minuten} minutes. That exceeds the 60 minutes even without waiting time at the neighbouring farm. The round should be split.
abholauftrag.regel: From the start of picking the clock runs until the produce is in the cold store. Up to {warnung} minutes the pickup counts as fine, up to {rot} minutes as a warning, beyond that as a violation. The neighbouring farm states when picking began. If it is missing, the pickup counts as a warning.
abholauftrag.verstossText: At least one pickup exceeded the limit of {grenze} minutes to the cold store. The produce is to be checked under the cold chain rules before it is processed or sold.
abholauftrag.zusammenfassungAbgeschlossen: The round is completed: {abgeholt} pickups, {entfallen} cancelled. This document no longer changes.
abholauftrag.zusammenfassungOffen: Order for {anzahl} stops. The driver records each pickup with the quantity and the start of picking that the neighbouring farm states.

posten.lead: One-off investment, recurring operating cost and expected benefit, per year. The figures above are calculated from these lines. If a whole type is missing, everything that depends on it stays open.
posten.keineZeile: No item of this type recorded yet.

modell.titel: Start with the values of the metric list
modell.lead: Nothing is recorded yet. The values of the metric list of 23 September 2026 can be taken over as a starting point: investment and recurring cost as evidenced, the back-calculated annual benefit as estimated. Every line can be changed afterwards.

investition.bezeichnung: Rollout of Damicon up to acceptance (fixed price)

betrieb.bezeichnung: Hosting, maintenance, support and further development

nutzen.bezeichnung: Total avoided cost (back-calculated from the given returns)

modell.notiz: Metric list of the management dated 23 September 2026

annahmen.vollkosten: Full cost per kg before the rollout
annahmen.mengeAusLieferungen: Sum of the delivered shipments of the last 12 months.
annahmen.mengeZuKurz: The deliveries only reach back {tage} days ({menge} kg so far). An annual quantity exists after a full year, or by hand under "Change assumptions".
annahmen.mengeKeine: No delivered shipment yet. The quantity can be set by hand.

form.echtbetriebHinweis: The plan versus actual comparison runs from here.

planIst.leer: No month yet. As soon as the start of live operation is set in the assumptions or an actual value exists, the comparison appears here.

staende.lead: A snapshot keeps items, assumptions and result, with the exchange rate of the day. It no longer changes. Later you can look up what was calculated back then.
staende.festhaltenLead: Saves today's state with items, actual values, assumptions and exchange rate.
staende.name: Name of the snapshot

abholrundenAnsicht.lead: A vehicle collects produce at neighbouring farms and brings it to the cold store. This is the opposite direction of the delivery tour planning.
abholrundenAnsicht.regel: From the start of picking, the 60-minute cold chain rule counts until the produce is in the cold store: up to 45 minutes fine, up to 60 minutes a warning, beyond that a violation. The neighbouring farm states when picking began, and the driver enters it at pickup. Without it, the pickup counts as a warning.
abholrundenAnsicht.nurLesen: Administration, CEO, operations management and accounting can plan. The drivers of the crew also record the progress.

runde.abErstem: {minuten} minutes of driving from the first stop to the cold store

integrationAuslieferung.cron: The cron service calls /api/integrationen/ausliefern with the secret CRON_SECRET. Without cron, the button below delivers.
integrationAuslieferung.nurAdmin: Administration and CEO can configure and retry.

warteschlange.leer: No event in the queue yet.

esf_frist_tage.label: Deadline for the ЭСФ
esf_frist_tage.beschreibung: The electronic invoice (ЭСФ) may be issued at the latest this many calendar days after the delivery day. After that the delivery counts as overdue in the list.

esutd_frist_abschluss_tage.label: ЕСУТД: deadline for a conclusion
esutd_frist_abschluss_tage.beschreibung: Working days after the start of the contract until it must be reported in the unified system. Saturday and Sunday do not count, public holidays are not stored.

esutd_frist_aenderung_tage.label: ЕСУТД: deadline for an amendment
esutd_frist_aenderung_tage.beschreibung: Calendar days after the day of the amendment until it must be reported.

esutd_frist_beendigung_tage.label: ЕСУТД: deadline for a termination
esutd_frist_beendigung_tage.beschreibung: Working days after the end of the contract until the termination must be reported. Saturday and Sunday do not count.

abholung_fahrzeug_kapazitaet_kg.label: Vehicle capacity of pickup rounds
abholung_fahrzeug_kapazitaet_kg.beschreibung: Payload of the refrigerated vehicle in kg. If a round plans more than this, the planning warns. Empty means: no check. A single round can carry its own capacity.

wirtschaftlichkeit_kalkulationszins_rich.label: Reference value for the discount rate
wirtschaftlichkeit_kalkulationszins_rich.beschreibung: Suggestion for the interest rate of the investment calculation as long as the farm enters no value of its own. Nominal, in percent.

wirtschaftlichkeit_zins_sensitivitaet_ni.label: Comparison rate, lower
wirtschaftlichkeit_zins_sensitivitaet_ni.beschreibung: Lower comparison calculation to the reference value, in percent.

wirtschaftlichkeit_zins_sensitivitaet_ho.label: Comparison rate, upper
wirtschaftlichkeit_zins_sensitivitaet_ho.beschreibung: Upper comparison calculation to the reference value, in percent.

auslieferung_zeitbudget_sekunden.label: Time budget of the delivery
auslieferung_zeitbudget_sekunden.beschreibung: A delivery run lasts at most this long. What has not been sent by then stays for the next run.

sicherheit_adresssuche_je_stunde.label: Limit of the address search
sicherheit_adresssuche_je_stunde.beschreibung: How often a person may have an address converted into coordinates per hour (geocoding).
